Mizar Partners Pty Ltd is an Australian professional accounting and business advisory firm with offices in Melbourne and Sydney. We provide accounting, taxation, compliance and business advisory services to individuals, sole traders, small and medium-sized businesses, and corporate clients across a wide range of industries.
Our services include bookkeeping, management accounting, taxation, tax planning, business advisory, cash flow management, SMSF support, entity structure advice, financial reporting and compliance support. We focus on providing practical accounting and taxation solutions to help clients maintain accurate financial records, meet their statutory obligations, understand their financial position and make informed business decisions.
Vacant Position: Senior Accountant 
We are seeking an experienced Accountant to join our senior level service team on a full-time basis. The successful applicant will be responsible for preparing, reviewing, analysing financial and taxation information for clients, assisting with statutory compliance, preparing financial statements and tax returns, supporting business advisory work, and providing professional accounting support across a range of client matters.
This role is suited to a professional with strong technical knowledge in accounting, taxation, financial reporting, business compliance, accounting systems, budget analysis, cash flow management and client advisory services.
Hiring Type: Permanent Full-time
Salary Range: Above AUD82,000 + super/ per year 
(The remuneration will depend on the skills, outcomes and experience you can deliver. )
Working Location: Melbourne
Qualification Requirements:
•	Above Master’s degree from Australia or overseas tertiary education provider is a must;
•	Must have a minimum of 3 years’ relevant accounting experience in public practice or business services.
•	Strong communication skills required, including proficiency in English and Mandarin.
•	Hands-on public practice experience delivering end-to-end tax, BAS and financial reporting services for Australian SME.
•	In-depth working knowledge of ATO legislation, payroll compliance, FBT, GST, PAYG and superannuation regulatory rules.
•	Strong proficiency with cloud accounting platforms and advanced Excel for financial modelling and reconciliation.
•	CPA/CA qualified or currently undertaking professional accounting accreditation will highly regarded.
•	Strong knowledge of Australian taxation law and compliance requirements.
•	Clear written and verbal communication skills to deliver straightforward financial advice to non- 
financial business owners.
•	Strong attention to detail and problem-solving ability.

Roles and Responsibility:
This is a senior level accounting service role, with core duties including:
?	Conduct payroll reviews fully compliant with ATO standards, including superannuation contribution calculations and salary packaging deduction audits.
?	Prepare month-end accounting deliverables: cash flow statements, journal entries, ad-hoc performance reports, monthly budgets, balance sheets and formal management reporting packs.
?	Prepare, reconcile and lodge all compliance documentation including Business Activity Statements (BAS), individual, company, partnership and super fund tax returns covering GST, PAYG instalments, PAYG withholding and all statutory tax obligations.
?	Design, update and refine internal financial workflows and general accounting procedures to boost operational efficiency and accuracy.
?	Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support for cloud-based accounting software systems used by internal teams and SME clients.
?	Compile complete financial statements (balance sheet, profit & loss, cash flow statements), conduct line-by-line account reviews and general ledger reconciliations, and deliver profitability, liquidity and financial health analysis to firm management and directors.
?	Prepare, validate and submit accurate annual Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) filings for all client entities.
?	Deliver customised professional taxation and structural advice to clients covering business setup,     
growth planning and daily operational financial optimisation.
?	Build robust financial control frameworks to protect client asset integrity, analyse operational expenses and track organisational income and expenditure trends.
?	Serve as the primary liaison for external auditors and support interim and year-end statutory audit procedures for all client portfolios.
?	Correspond and negotiate directly with the Australian Taxation Office (ATO) and other financial regulatory authorities as required for client compliance matters.

## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Database Administrator to join our team and take ownership of the design, implementation, and ongoing management of our database systems. The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring the integrity, security, and performance of organisational data assets. This role suits a proactive and technically proficient professional with a strong background in database management and a commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality data infrastructure. Experience working within a collaborative IT environment and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders will be highly regarded.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain database architecture, data structures, tables, and naming conventions to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and completeness of all data master files
- Establish, monitor, and maintain backup and recovery procedures, ensuring business continuity and minimal disruption in the event of a system failure
- Implement and enforce database security protocols, integrity controls, and access management policies to safeguard sensitive organisational data
- Administer and maintain comprehensive database documentation, including guidelines, policies, and operational procedures, ensuring these remain current and fit for purpose
- Plan and perform database upgrades, patches, and migrations, including thorough testing, debugging, and issue resolution in accordance with approved quality assurance processes
- Monitor database performance on an ongoing basis, identifying bottlenecks and implementing tuning, indexing, and optimisation strategies to maximise efficiency
- Collaborate with developers, systems analysts, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into effective and scalable database solutions
- Analyse existing database systems and workflows, recommending and implementing improvements to enhance reliability, performance, and maintainability
- Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance for database-related incidents, working to resolve issues promptly and minimise operational impact
- Ensure database environments comply with relevant data governance frameworks, privacy legislation, and organisational standards, including alignment with Australian Privacy Principles where applicable
- Assist in capacity planning activities by assessing current usage trends and forecasting future storage and performance requirements
- Support the development and maintenance of data integration processes, including ETL pipelines and data warehouse environments, in collaboration with cross-functional teams
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
- Demonstrated experience in a Database Administrator or similar role, with hands-on responsibility for managing enterprise-level database environments
- Proficiency in one or more leading relational database management systems, such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL
- Strong working knowledge of SQL, including query writing, stored procedures, functions, and performance tuning
- Experience designing and implementing backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies in production environments
- Solid understanding of database security principles, including user access controls, encryption, and audit logging
- Ability to diagnose and resolve complex database performance issues through monitoring tools, execution plans, and indexing strategies
- Familiarity with data modelling techniques and the ability to translate business requirements into well-structured database designs
- Sound understanding of IT service management practices and experience working within structured change management processes
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a methodical approach to troubleshooting
- Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to liaise confidently with both technical teams and business stakeholders
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant vendor certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, Oracle Database Administrator Certified Professional, or equivalent
- Experience with cloud-based database platforms, including Azure SQL, Amazon RDS, or Google Cloud SQL
- Exposure to NoSQL database technologies such as MongoDB, Cassandra, or Redis
- Experience in data warehousing environments and familiarity with ETL tools and processes
- Knowledge of scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash for automation of routine database tasks
- Familiarity with DevOps practices and experience working within Agile or ITIL-aligned environments
- Prior experience in a regulated industry such as finance, healthcare, or government, with an understanding of associated compliance obligations
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive and collaborative team culture that values continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional development
- Access ongoing training opportunities, certification support, and clear pathways for career progression within a growing technology function
- Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work options, to support a healthy work-life balance
- Work on meaningful, complex data challenges that have a genuine impact across the organisation
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with additional benefits including superannuation, annual leave loading, and access to an employee wellbeing programme
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

result.description:
Alba Italian Restaurant is seeking a qualified and experienced Chef to join our kitchen team in Newtown.
Alba is an independently operated Italian restaurant specialising in the cuisine of Southern Italy. Our menu focuses on house-made pasta, traditional recipes, quality Australian produce and modern interpretations of regional Italian dishes.
About the role

The Chef will be responsible for preparing and presenting dishes consistently, supporting the daily operation of the kitchen and maintaining Alba’s food-quality and food-safety standards.
The position requires availability across a rotating roster, including evenings, weekends and public holidays.

Main responsibilities
Prepare, cook and present menu items according to established recipes and presentation standards.
Assist with the preparation of fresh pasta, sauces, meat, seafood, vegetable dishes and desserts.
Monitor food quality at all stages of preparation and service.
Manage assigned kitchen sections during preparation and service.
Assist with menu development, monthly specials and recipe testing.
Monitor and maintain food quality at all stages of preparation and service
Monitor and control stock levels, food storage, portion sizes and wastage
Follow food safety, hygiene and WHS procedures
Assist with stock control, supplier liaison and inventory management
Assist with receiving, checking and storing deliveries.
Work collaboratively with the Head Chef and other kitchen employees.
Provide guidance and training to junior kitchen employees where required.

Skills and experience
Applicants should have:
Proven experience as a Chef de Partie in a high-volume à la carte environment 
A relevant qualification in commercial cookery or hospitality or at least 3 years of relevant experience.
Strong knowledge of food preparation, cooking techniques, food safety and kitchen organisation.
The ability to manage a section independently during service.
Good communication, teamwork and time-management skills.
A genuine interest in Italian and Southern Italian cuisine.
Experience preparing fresh pasta or regional Italian dishes will be highly regarded.

Employment conditions
Permanent, full-time employment.
Salary between $80,000 and $85,000 based on experience
Approximately 38 hours per week, with reasonable additional hours where required.
Evening, weekend and public-holiday work will be required.

How to apply
Please submit your résumé and a brief cover letter outlining your qualifications, relevant restaurant experience and availability.
Applications will be assessed on demonstrated skills, qualifications and experience.

result.description:
Margaret River, Full Time, Hospitality
Vacancy Listing Dates 24/07/2026 to 21/08/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17458
- Hotel Manager, Hotel Service Manager, Landscape Gardener, and Handyperson roles
- Full time positions available
- Opportunities with the Grande Escape Resort in Margaret River

The Grande Escape Resort in Margaret River have the following vacancies on offer:
- Hotel Manager
- Hotel Service Manager
- Landscape Gardener
- Handyperson

Hotel Manager

The manager will assume responsibility for overseeing day-to-day operations, ensuring guest satisfaction, directing staff, and maintaining profitability. The multifaceted responsibilities of this position demand business acumen, exceptional interpersonal skills, exceptional problem-solving skills and a genuine passion for guest service.

We are seeking a Hotel Manager to:
- Manage hotel services - accommodation and food and beverage.
- Oversee events and conferences.
- Manage corporate bookings and enquiries.
- Human resource management.
- Troubleshoot any issues arising in hotel operations.
- Liaise with contractors and suppliers.
- Supervise any maintenance work and renovations.
- Safeguard security and compliance, conducting inspections where necessary.
- Manage heads of departments or entire teams including supervision of ordering stock
- Drive forward sales strategies and oversee expenditure
- Handle financial responsibilities by ensuring high occupancy levels,
- Manage budgets and controlling expenditures.
- Track hotel revenues, setting sales targets and optimise profits.
- Analyse sales figures, reports and the different market segments and channels to define the best-suited pricing and distribution strategies.
- Maintain statistical and financial records.
- Monitor and motivate staff with constructive communication in a positive work environment and a shared vision of targets and career progression.

Skills and Qualifications:
- Diploma or degree in hospitality management or a related field.
- Two to five years of experience in a supervisory or management capacity within the hospitality industry.
- Exceptional leadership, interpersonal, and organisational abilities.
- Ability to lead people not just manage them.
- Proficiency in computer applications and hospitality management systems (RMS is preferable or similar).
- Willingness to work variable shifts, including weekends and holidays.
- Possess a police check or the ability to complete the check.

Hotel Service Manager

We are seeking a Hotel Service Manager to supervise daily operations and coordinate hotel service workers to ensure exceptional guest experiences. This will involve managing teams across front office, housekeeping, and concierge, balancing staff rosters, resolving grievances, and maintaining rigorous safety standards.

Key Responsibilities:
- Directs and delegates duties to housekeepers, maintenance and reception staff.
- Maintains attendance records, manages shift rosters, resolves staff grievances, and enforces safety regulations.
- Perform front office reception duties and ensure all hotel amenities meet strict brand and hygiene standards.
- Oversees the efficiency of hotel units and suggests operational improvements.

Qualifications & Requirements:
- Requires an AQF Certificate III/IV or Diploma in hospitality management.
- Requires two to three years of relevant on-the-job training or industry experience.
- Specialisation as a Front Office Manager with housekeeping experience; Food and beverage an advantage

Landscape Gardener

We are also seeking a Landscape Gardener to join our team, applicants must have at least 2-3 years' experience in a similar role.

Duties include:
- Preparing and maintaining seedbeds and growing sites
- Propagating and planting trees, bushes, hedges, flowers and bulbs
- Preparing lawn areas by spreading top soil and planting grass, and by laying instant turf
- Maintaining planted and grassed areas by weeding, trimming, fertilising, watering and mowing
- Ensuring the grounds are clean for guests
- Pruning trees and hedges, and installing plant support and protection devices
- Preparing plans and drawings, selecting materials and plants, and scheduling landscape construction
- Setting out and installing hardscape and softscape structures
- Constructing gravel and paved areas, walls, fences, pergolas, ponds, barbecues and garden furniture
- Examining trees to assess their condition and determine treatment
- Lopping limbs off trees and shaping branches using chain and handsaws
- Spraying and dusting plants and trees to control insects and disease, and felling diseased trees

Handyperson

In addition, we require a Handyperson to join our team full time as well.

You will be responsible for:
- General repairs around the property and rooms.
- Plumbing repairs including Unblocking sinks, fixing leaky taps, and replacing tap washers.
- Simple electrical repairs
- Painting and carpentry repairs to ensure the rooms and grounds are in good condition
- Outdoor maintenance such as clearing gutters, fixing fences, mowing lawns, and general yard upkeep.

Applicants must have:
- At least 1 year of experience in a similar role
- Proficiency in using hand and power tools.
- Basic working knowledge of carpentry, plumbing, and electrical systems
- Ability to perform manual labour, including lifting heavy objects and standing for long periods.
- Strong communication skills
- A valid driver's licence and relevant construction induction training (e.g., White Card in Australia)

A salary between $70,000 - $100,000 will be offered to the successful candidates.

If you are ready to take your career to the next level in a challenging, busy yet rewarding position, this may be the perfect opportunity for you.

Apply now! -
https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17458.php

Sponsorship may be available to the right person.
